description: AGSC-06-17 as amended for 1.0.0: the served Content-Security-Policy contains at least default-src 'none', script-src 'self', style-src 'self', img-src 'self' and connect-src 'self' and admits no inline script, and the case asserts that it CONTAINS these directives, never the whole string — a writer MAY add directives that only restrict further. Derivation from the rule text: each of the five is a directive name with one source, so a policy contains it when it carries a directive of that name whose source list includes that source; inline script is admitted by 'unsafe-inline', 'unsafe-hashes', a nonce source or a hash source in the directive that governs scripts (script-src-elem and script-src-attr where present, else script-src, else default-src), so none of them may appear there. The policy is served on every address, which the Cloudflare Pages profile of this case writes as the pattern /*. The two content types are asserted whole, as the rule states them, and the profile's header fallback of AGSC-06-07 is the whole header line. AGSC-06-01 makes the header set and not the file format normative, so no _headers bytes are asserted. This case supersedes build-0012, which asserted two of the five directives; the legacy redirect that build-0012 also asserted is a SHOULD of the same rule and is not asserted here.
